task: skeptic VALUE+FEASIBILITY for R20ID-1 (insertion cap curve non-monotone; lab agrees in sign for cap>=12 fc2)
reason: The numbers are right: an2.json and an3.json reproduce every delta quoted, e.g. cap24_fc2 +0.001883 ALL, 44b6 0, 6bba +0.002037, extras vs cap6 5 TP / 12 FP / 303 ign. The inference drawn from them does not hold. (1) Not robust: I ran a 56-clip bootstrap and a leave-one-out (scratchpad/r20ins/boot_v.py). No arm's 90% CI excludes 0. vs cap6: cap12_fc2 +0.00123 [-0.00100, +0.00385], P>0 0.79; cap24_fc2 +0.00188 [-0.00045, +0.00491], P>0 0.90. vs K2: cap24_fc2 +0.00131, P>0 0.71. Dropping the top 2 of 56 clips turns every arm negative: cap12_fc2 -0.00027, cap24_fc2 -0.00028 vs cap6, and -0.0009 vs K2. The same three 6bba clips carry every arm (9a41d029, 337b1b3a, 3fda6b25), and 44b6 is exactly 0 for all caps >= 6. So 'lab now agrees in sign with public' rests on ~3-5 TP events on one embryo, with in-sample DaughterNet. (2) 'Rises steadily to cap 24 fc2' is a winner's-curse reading. Uncapped fc2 (691 insertions) falls back to +0.00129, so cap24_fc2 is the maximum of 29 noisy arms, not the top of a trend. The lab cannot rank cap 12/16/24/uncapped. (3) The action's 'volume axis' choices do not follow from this fact. The lab PREFERS thr 0.3 (cap24_fc2_t03 +0.00282), so thr 0.4 comes from the MC/priors. fc2 vs fc3 at cap 12 differs by 1.6e-4, about one FP event. 'steal off loses' is one lost 44b6 TP (div 1/8/10 vs 2/9/9). The only many-event piece is no-frame-cap adjusted edge -0.00055 (519 steals). (4) Private value: this is the only private-side evidence, and it is null on 44b6 and fragile on 6bba. Logging it as a positive transfer signal would make a public knob pick look lab-backed. Feasibility is fine: logging only; knob rungs run under the user's 11:14/11:16Z aggressive-mode lift; cap/fc/thr add no runtime. The issue is value/interpretation, not feasibility.
fix: Log in CONTEXT as a lab NULL, not a sign agreement: 'R20ID-1 lab (in-sample, 56 clips): cap >= 8 vs cap6 +0.0006..+0.0019 pooled, 44b6 = 0, all from 6bba; clip-bootstrap CI90 includes 0 for every arm; dropping 2 of 56 clips (6bba_9a41d029, 6bba_337b1b3a) flips every arm negative; uncapped fc2 < cap24 fc2 (no monotone trend). Lab cannot rank caps or fc/thr and gives no private evidence for any DIV volume file. Only robust item: no frame cap costs adj edge -0.00055 (steal edge damage) -> keep fc <= 2.' Pick cap rungs, if any, on the public read under the user's lift, with the DIV finals caveat unchanged ('cap/threshold picked on the public embryo; lab null'). Do not cite R20ID-1 as support for a DIV volume file as a final.
realistic_gain: 0 LB directly (logging item). Decision value is small: at most it justifies keeping frame cap <= 2 and steal on, which the rungs already have. It gives no basis to prefer cap 24 over cap 12, and no private-side support. Expected private effect of any cap >= 12 file vs K2, from this lab: centred ~+0.001 with a CI spanning about -0.0016..+0.005.
